hook: Your torch here lights crystal beams nearly as long as a bus.
title: The Cave With Bus-Sized Crystal Beams
description:
The Cave of the Crystals in Naica, Mexico holds giant white gypsum beams, the biggest around eleven meters long. The cave is dangerously hot and humid, so people cannot stay long without protective gear. Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Mexico #Geography
